verdict.rationale: Apify provides a CLI and REST/OpenAPI API (apify-docs-3, apify-probe-2, apify-probe-4) that could be used to pull data out of the platform, implying some data portability, but the evidence pack never documents actual dataset export formats (e.g., JSON/CSV/Excel) or an explicit 'export and leave' workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of dataset export formats, confirmation of full data portability/deletion, and independent verification that a user can fully migrate data out.
